document.title: [Bug]: DSpark draft token count inflated by reusing target DP sync state with adaptive verification
document.body:
### Your current environment
The output of python collect_env.py ```text commit id: ac71b175172f2c092d7141f41f0777b914788cfb ```
### 🐛 Describe the bug With adaptive verification and DP enabled, DSpark reuses the target model’s DP sync state, whose `num_reqs` may reflect the target CUDA graph’s padded request capacity rather than the logical request count. This causes unnecessary padding in the draft batch. For example, a single request requiring 7 draft query tokens is expanded to 112 tokens when the target graph has a request capacity of 16. The drafter then selects and replays a 133-token CUDA graph. This issue appears to share the same root cause as #58984. * serve script ```text vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \ --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 --trust-remote-code \ --data-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel \ --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 16384 --max-num-seqs 256 \ --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 \ --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes":[16,32,64,128,256,512],"max_cudagraph_capture_size":512}' \ --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","attention_backend":"FLASH_ATTN","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","enable_adaptive_verification":true}' ``` * profiling result ### Before submitting a new issue... - [x] Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the [documentation page](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/), which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
